title: Impact of Class Size Cap Policy on Reading Scores

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

The research question aims to determine the causal effect of a class size cap policy on students' reading scores. The dataset provides information on individual schools (`unit_id`), academic years (`period`), a binary indicator for whether a school was subject to the policy (`treated`), a binary indicator for the period after policy implementation (`post`), and an interaction term (`treat_x_post`). The outcome variable `y` represents reading scores in standard deviation units.

This data structure is perfectly suited for a **Difference-in-Differences (DID)** estimation strategy.
